query: What satisfaction and complaint themes appear in Yelp reviews?

per_column.name: staff_professionalism_attitude
per_column.rationale: Service/staff experience is a genuine aspect of dining satisfaction/complaints, a part-of the concept.

per_column.name: order_accuracy_timeliness
per_column.rationale: Order fulfillment (accuracy and speed) is a distinct constitutive aspect of the restaurant experience customers praise or complain about.

per_column.name: flavor_quality_rating
per_column.rationale: Taste/flavor of food is a core aspect of satisfaction; clearly an aspect-of the concept.

per_column.name: portion_adequacy
per_column.rationale: Portion size is a distinct food-related aspect of value/satisfaction, part-of the concept.

per_column.name: food_freshness_temperature
per_column.rationale: Freshness/temperature is a distinct quality dimension of food, separate from flavor; a constitutive facet.

per_column.name: ambiance_atmosphere
per_column.rationale: Atmosphere/environment is a recognized aspect of the dining experience contributing to satisfaction or complaint.

per_column.name: pricing_value_perception
per_column.rationale: Price/value is a standard facet customers evaluate; an aspect-of overall satisfaction.

per_column.name: cleanliness_standard
per_column.rationale: Cleanliness/hygiene is a distinct constitutive aspect of the venue experience, part-of the concept.

judge.rationale: Every added column is a genuine constitutive facet (aspect-of) of restaurant satisfaction/complaint themes rather than an external predictor, cause, or restatement of the whole. The set is largely non-overlapping across service, food, environment, and value dimensions. Minor overlap exists within the food cluster (flavor, portion, freshness/temperature all sub-partition 'food quality' and could bleed into each other, e.g. 'quality' vs 'freshness'), slightly lowering mutual exclusivity. Coverage is strong across the major experiential aspects of a Yelp restaurant review; small gaps remain (e.g., wait/reservation experience, accessibility/location/parking, menu variety), preventing full exhaustiveness. Overall a well-constructed MECE facet decomposition.
